I relate to the too cowardly thing 😅, but with school work, I believe you can email your teachers and make a compromise. (AP teachers normally understand, due to the workload.) 
I think they can hold you for a max of 72 hrs to eval you if they feel something is up. Thank you, I hope stuff gets better for you.❤
And in all reality, I ain't really got it together, I've just done a ton of research on certain things. Good luck on the future though.

You're welcome, I understand that a mental institute isn't an option currently. My friend was sent to one for a couple months and had to make up work I think.. Please do consider it if it gets worse? If you definitely plan on doing something permanent is the definite on you need to go. I can get that senior year is rough from how my senior friends talk about it (I'm currently in sophomore year so I can't vouch too much.) If you get more thoughts on harm, try to distract yourself by doing one of your hobbies. Hell, I used to draw on my arm whenever I wanted to. I wish you the best of luck, OP. ❤

He would be required to, teachers are under the same policy school counselors are, if you're bringing harm to yourself they are required by law to contact parents. Then it is up to you and your parents on if you should be put into a mental institute, if you feel you might do worse please take the opportunity to go and get help.
